info.title: runware/runware-nano-banana-2
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "runware/runware-nano-banana-2", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: One Runware `imageInference` task, sent as a single JSON object. Router fills in the parts the model's path already decides: `taskType` is set to `imageInference`, `model` to this model's Runware AIR id, `deliveryMethod` to `sync` and `includeCost` to `true`, overriding anything the body carries for those four, and a `taskUUID` is generated when the body has none or sends null. `positivePrompt` is required. Runware's other imageInference fields (`outputFormat`, `inputs.referenceImages`, `providerSettings`, ...) are accepted and forwarded unchanged; Runware validates them, and supported `width`/`height` pairs vary by model.

example.positivePrompt: A watercolor fox curled up in a snowy pine forest

height.description: Output height in pixels. Not required by this schema; the supported width/height pairs vary by model and Runware validates them. The 12288 ceiling is nano-banana-2's 4K `8:1`/`1:8` edge.

model.description: Optional; always overridden with this model's Runware AIR id.

numberResults.description: Number of images to generate (1-20, Runware's documented bound for these models). Each result is billed at the cost Runware reports for it.

positivePrompt.description: The prompt describing the image to generate.

taskUUID.description: Optional client-chosen UUID v4 for the task. Generated when absent or null. Runware documents this field as a UUID v4, so the pattern pins the version nibble to `4` and the variant nibble to `[89abAB]` rather than accepting any UUID-shaped string.

width.description: Output width in pixels. Not required by this schema; the supported width/height pairs vary by model and Runware validates them. The 12288 ceiling is nano-banana-2's 4K `8:1`/`1:8` edge.

200.description: OK - the provider's native result document, returned unchanged. Comfy has not described this model's output yet, so neither its shape nor its media type is narrowed here; the provider's own documentation is authoritative.

schema.description: Comfy has not described this model's result document yet. Router returns the provider's native output unchanged, so the provider's own documentation is authoritative for the response shape.
